clips.title: 韦德布什证券丹·艾夫斯：Mag7下半年将显著跑赢当前回调是买入良机

subtitles.en: Dan Ives of Wet Bush writing text talks have way oversold in June.
subtitles.zh: 韦德布什的丹·艾夫斯表示，六月科技股被过度抛售。

subtitles.en: They ultimately represent major buying opportunities as these bearish narratives have overshadowed the future massive growth prospects.
subtitles.zh: 这实际上是重大买入机会，因为看空叙事掩盖了未来巨大的增长前景。

subtitles.en: Dan joins us now, and of course, when we're talking about tech, we're talking about hyperscalers in particular, which have been the huge losers until yesterday, where you actually saw a little bit of a turnaround.
subtitles.zh: 丹加入我们。谈到科技，特别是超大规模企业，它们此前是最大输家，直到昨天才有所反弹。

subtitles.en: Why do you reject the notion that people are pushing back against the spending plans of some of these technical chemists?
subtitles.zh: 为什么你拒绝接受人们质疑这些科技公司支出计划的观点？

subtitles.en: Look, the hyperscalers is 700 billion. I mean, that's what's funding the AI revolution.
subtitles.zh: 超大规模企业投入7000亿美元，这支撑了AI革命。

subtitles.en: I mean, when you talk about memory, chips, Nvidia, and everything else, but that's just the first phase, because what the hyperscalers are doing is this is the build out.
subtitles.zh: 谈到内存、芯片、英伟达等，这只是第一阶段，超大规模企业正在进行基础设施建设。

subtitles.en: It's Vegas strip building in 1955, but ultimately the monetization now is going to come.
subtitles.zh: 这就像1955年拉斯维加斯大道建设，但最终变现即将到来。

subtitles.en: I mean, when you look at meta, they're not just spending to spend, you look at Microsoft, they essentially own the enterprise alphabet, 5% of their customers have gone to the AI
subtitles.zh: Meta并非盲目支出，微软几乎拥有企业级市场，Alphabet有5%客户转向AI。

subtitles.en: path. Same thing with Amazon. So my whole point is you've had this tech rally, but mags have right now a penalty box essentially.
subtitles.zh: 亚马逊也是如此。科技股上涨，但Mag 7目前处于受罚席。

subtitles.en: I think it's significantly outperforms second half of the year, and I think earning season as you see in July, and this will be a huge evaluation moment for big tech.
subtitles.zh: 我认为下半年它们将显著跑赢，7月财报季将是大型科技股的关键评估时刻。

subtitles.en: So the Vegas strip maybe is a decent analogy on the just actuality of it, not in the scale.
subtitles.zh: 拉斯维加斯大道或许是个不错的类比，但规模上不可同日而语。

subtitles.en: I mean, we're talking JP Morgan expecting five and a half trillion dollars to spend on CapExpend for AI heading out to 2030.
subtitles.zh: 摩根大通预计，到2030年AI资本支出将达5.5万亿美元。

subtitles.en: We're talking about massive numbers that are accelerating, not decelerating, and capacity constrained companies, right?
subtitles.zh: 这些数字巨大且加速增长，而非放缓，企业产能受限。
